definitions.explanation: The first month of the year. In Japan, January is significant for New Year celebrations (お{正月|しょうがつ}, oshōgatsu).

examples.japanese: {一月|いちがつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to Japan in January.

examples.japanese: {一月|いちがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{一月|いちがつ}⟦{一日|ついたち}→一日：10993_tsuitachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{元日|がんじつ}→元日：00059_ganjitsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{一月|いちがつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{初|はじ}め→初め：02931_hajime⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦{休|やす}みます→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: The beginning of January is the New Year holiday, and everyone takes time off.

examples.japanese: {一月|いちがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われています→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: January is said to be the coldest month of the year.

notes:
{一月|いちがつ} is January - literally "month one."

MONTH PATTERN:
Number + ⟦{月|がつ}→月：noentry⟧ = month name. All 12 months follow this pattern.

PRONUNCIATION:
- {一月|いちがつ}: January (the month)
- ⟦{一月|ひとつき}→一月：22860_hitotsuki⟧: one month (duration) - different reading

CULTURAL NOTE:
- ⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧: New Year holiday (first days of January)
- ⟦{元日|がんじつ}→元日：00059_ganjitsu⟧/⟦{元旦|がんたん}→元旦：14874_gantan⟧: New Year's Day (January 1st)
- ⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧: first shrine visit of the year
- ⟦{成人|せいじん}→成人：03378_seijin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: Coming of Age Day (second Monday)

NEW YEAR GREETINGS:
- ⟦{明|あ}けまして→明ける：21288_akeru⟧⟦おめでとう→おめでとう：01043_omedetou⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧: Happy New Year
